name: Lavipharm S.A.
summary: Lavipharm S.A. engages in the research, development, manufacture, import, marketing, sale, and wholesale of pharmaceutical, cosmetics, and healthcare products to physicians and pharmacists in Greece and internationally. The company offers pharmaceutical products for cardiology, oncology-urology, central nervous system, chronic pain, and self- treatment. It also provides prescription medicines and over the counter (OTC) products, as well as LIFELAB CBD products. The company was founded in 1911 and is based in Paiania, Greece.
